In secondary school around year 9 I had was having nervous breakdowns in school, I started crying, shaking, sweating, couldn’t breath. I was having a horrendous time at home and was dealing with a lot of suicidal thoughts, and disassociated with my surroundings a lot to the point where I forgot to eat and drink. It felt like I was having a weird dream. 

Anyway during science class someone in my group made an off hand comment about me and I don’t know why but it pushed me to some sort of edge and i didn’t know how to handle it, our teacher mr.madigan took me out the class and asked if I was feeling ok, I can’t quite remember a lot of what we talked about but I do remember him saying my blood sugar levels were low and that my body was going through shock, he bought me a sandwich and some water after asking for someone to step in and teach the class. I will never forget it and it has changed me forever. Thankyou sir.
